description: Create a new draft film from a title, exactly as the Studio's add-film dialog does. The draft starts as Buy or rent with no prices, no poster and no files, and is not public until publish_film. Returns the film's id, editor link and publish checklist (the same shape as get_film), so the next steps are update_film (details, access: free or paid, prices), start_film_upload (main film), the poster in the film editor, then publish_film.

title.description: The film's title (up to 200 characters); everything else is set afterwards.
